offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures pumps, valves, friction products and connectors and sensors for industrial, energy, transportation and aerospace customers. Sells mainly to original equipment makers and industrial operators, through direct sales, distributors and aftermarket channels.

primary_products.value: pumps; valves; brake pads and friction components; connectors; sensors

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas operators, chemical plants, mining companies, rail operators, aerospace and industrial manufacturers

end_markets.value: oil and gas; chemical and petrochemical; power generation; mining; rail; aerospace; industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: pumps, valves, friction components and connectors sold to manufacturers and operators; service fees: aftermarket parts, maintenance and repair for installed equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds pumps, valves, friction products and connectors, sold to equipment makers and operators; component supplier: supplies friction and connector components to rail, aerospace and industrial original equipment makers

geography_served.value: global: Sells and manufactures across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions
